reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I030 execution is valid: donor/target identities are disjoint, the frozen I029 K=3 donor rule and negative-control map are unchanged, all selected first-ready references preserve eight joint frames, target benchmark coverage is 125/126 (99.21%), all donor domains have 18 ready donors, and NS/VAD shipping mirrors are exact. In the preregistered pre-ready-speech population (72 paired cases), matched donors beat the fixed negative control on gap in 43 cases and lost in 29, with median gap improvement +0.01661. The simple hypothesis that failures are primarily caused by between-donor pool dispersion is not supported: matched-worse and matched-better cases have similar median between-donor gap MAD (0.03279 vs 0.02945). Failure cases instead show larger within-donor gap MAD (0.04879 vs 0.03207), larger target gap MAD (0.06691 vs 0.05268), larger matched gap error (0.13657 vs 0.04661), and larger gap-alignment error (0.04194 vs 0.02399). A deterministic algebraic review of the preserved joint summaries shows that the independent component-median aggregation can break the shipping identity gap=clamp(concentration-mean): in pre-ready matched-worse cases the median absolute inconsistency of the matched aggregate is 0.04537 versus 0.01179 in matched-better cases, while target-benchmark inconsistency remains about 0.002 in both groups. This is a reviewed mathematical interpretation of preregistered joint evidence, not a new candidate test. Condition heterogeneity also persists: bus is strongly adverse (14/18 gap losses, median improvement -0.06009), field is only slightly adverse overall (10/18 losses, -0.00447), while living (16/18 wins, +0.25089) and cafeteria (13/18 wins, +0.05009) are clearly positive. Therefore I030 selects no donor/reference candidate and does not authorize donor-rule tuning. The next question is whether a single preregistered joint-coherent aggregation operator removes the structural inconsistency without changing donor selection.

root_cause_review.note: Association/decomposition only. I030 does not establish that correcting joint-summary algebra is sufficient to produce a usable or shippable reference.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: Use entirely fresh, disjoint donor and target public-development seeds. Freeze the I029/I030 K=3 donor selection function and negative-control map byte-for-byte. Keep the original independent-component-median aggregate as a frozen control. Evaluate exactly one preregistered joint-coherent aggregation operator: pool the 24 selected donor first-ready joint frames, compute the component-wise median center only as a locator, then select the single observed joint frame with minimum unweighted L1 distance to that center (deterministic tie-break by seed-bound donor case key then frame index). Because the selected output is an observed joint frame, it preserves gap=clamp(concentration-mean) by construction. Compare control versus joint-coherent matched-donor gap error against the unchanged target first-ready median-gap benchmark, globally, in pre-ready-speech cases, and in preregistered bus/field/living/cafeteria slices. Also report algebraic inconsistency exactly; no donor matching, K, negative-control or threshold tuning is allowed. This is an aggregation-coherence diagnostic only, not a reference-source candidate test.
required_gates: fresh donor and target seeds disjoint from I025-I030
I029/I030 K=3 donor selection function frozen byte-for-byte/AST-equivalent
joint-coherent operator returns one actually observed donor joint frame
same-target future frames never enter donor reference
prohibited: search across multiple joint aggregation operators
assumption that development matching metadata is available in shipping

verification_limits: I030 is development-only; donor matching uses synthetic/development metadata and does not establish shipping metadata availability.
The algebraic inconsistency review is a deterministic interpretation of preserved joint evidence, not a preregistered candidate comparison and not shipping authority.
Higher within-donor/target MAD and alignment error in matched-worse cases are associations; case-level causal sufficiency was not tested.
Bus adverse transfer replicated strongly; field did not replicate as a comparably strong adverse domain, so bus/field must not be treated as one homogeneous failure class.

No donor-rule redesign, reference-source candidate, component counterfactual, mapping, threshold, tracker change, validation-grade, blind, HIL, product-certification, source-merge or release authority was consumed.
